editor.premise: A family catches up on a troubled camper journey, using breakdowns, roadside friendships, and travel memories before returning to everyday life aboard.

chapters.name: Journey recap
chapters.purpose: Explain the journey and establish the mechanical trouble through flashbacks.

chapters.name: Finding repair help
chapters.purpose: Connect roadside encounters to efforts to get moving again.

chapters.name: Visiting friends
chapters.purpose: Give the repair story a social detour before resuming travel.

chapters.name: Driving west
chapters.purpose: Compress distance, arrival, and another repair into a short travel passage.

chapters.name: Camper afternoon
chapters.purpose: Return to present-tense family life and practical talk inside the camper.

captions.note: Mostly short lower-center dialogue captions; maps and occasional emphasis labels occupy the center or top. Words follow brief clips rather than narrating continuously.

editor.notes: Use the seated conversation as a home base. Interrupt explanations with brief evidence, then return before orientation is lost. Hold complete thoughts longer than travel inserts. Maps compress geography; imperfect phone footage supplies immediacy without needing full scenes.
